introduction: Explore a mining village and its silverworking, gem cutting, jewelry setting and magical-necklace leads. All twelve native exchanges are support services, with no quest or daily achievements. Several advertised recipes disagree with their current contracts. Active, ready accounting is required; paid exchanges remain guarded.
orientation: Surface hills reach the village approach from the south and west; two southeastern mine exits connect to the Underdark. A further eastern branch points to an unavailable old-world destination. Check an actual open route before travel.

The intended crafting story runs from silver ore to five pure bars, a plain necklace, five cut gems, a set necklace and a rare platinum disc, then rainbow enchantment. Current recipes disagree with that sequence. This journal explains the actual exchanges and their blockers instead of promising the intended outcome.

Ten raw-gem kinds share a visible name and aliases. Silver ore and pure silver bars are separate kinds. Current material checks distinguish exact kinds and quantities; five interchangeable-looking gems need not satisfy a five-copy contract.

Ordinary and magical gem-set necklaces share a visible name. The magical kind holds rainbow charges and is currently created directly by the five-raw-gem service. A current receipt does not replace an unequipped necklace after it has been used or consumed.

Real gold ore and pyrite also share a visible name. Real gold and pyrite are separately declared in eastern ore shafts. Only real gold matches the current magic-shop contract, whose required disc is unavailable.

The disc rumor describes a ranger, forest and kobold suspicion. It does not establish an active foreign recovery route, item grant or personal-source achievement. A similarly described foreign disc has a different identity and cannot substitute in the current recipe.

Current carried-material checks are optional preparation aids. Supplied matching items fit without prior crafting, personal mining, a paid rumor or learned keywords. No check proves first recovery, and no service receipt earns a quest achievement.

All twelve paid native exchanges remain unavailable under active accounting. Carrying every visible material does not override the payment guard, missing disc or missing jewelry rewards. Recipe repairs and safe payment integration need qualification before a fresh journey.

Gem and ore declarations, merchant inventories and alternative foreign or random-effect sources are leads. Caps, actual stock, custody and accepted acquisition still matter. Ordinary skill mining is guarded while item accounting is active and is different from picking up predeclared ore.

Guild teaching, class gates, shops, room rental, town justice and guard keys are separate support systems. Four named guildguard prototypes have gate procedures but are not placed by local resets; the cleric teacher occupies his gate position. Access rules need a deliberate builder review.

The stable lists a cave-spider hireling in its adjacent storage room. Pet purchase, rental and claim operations are guarded under active accounting. The old claim path reports a return without restoring the pet and needs repair before it can support a quest step.

The dump is also guarded while accounting is active. Drunken chatter and janitor pickup are ambient behavior. Orc, giant, beast and mine danger descriptions contain no local accepted rescue, clearance or village-defense outcome.

stories.title: The current refining exchange
stories.summary: Dialogue offers silver refining for one silver. The current exchange instead consumes one raw gem and 10 copper, returning a different raw gem with the same visible name. It is a support service, guarded while accounting is active; it earns no quest achievement.

steps.text: Carry the raw gem required by the refining exchange
steps.hint: This exact raw gem is declared on the ground in the southeastern end of the gem mines. Silver ore, a silver bar and other same-named raw gems do not substitute. Current custody does not prove personal mining.

Ask nugget, ore, silver, cost, price or money at the smith. The actual result remains a raw gem. The room sign says five silver, dialogue mentions an old twenty-five-silver sign, and the contract charges one silver. The recipe and sign need deliberate repair before promising refined silver.

stories.title: Five raw gems for a magical necklace
stories.summary: Dialogue describes five pure silver bars and twenty-five gold. The current contract consumes five copies of one exact raw gem and 2,500 copper, producing a magical gem-set necklace with three rainbow charges. This guarded support recipe earns no quest or daily achievement.

steps.text: Optional history: use the current refining exchange
steps.hint: This optional receipt explains a current output source. Supplied exact material also fits. History does not replace current custody or bypass unavailable payments.

steps.text: Carry five copies of the exact raw gem
steps.hint: The exact kind is declared in the eastern gem-mining pocket and is also the output of the refining exchange. Five different raw gems, silver bars or an earlier receipt do not satisfy this count. Supplied matching copies fit.

Ask necklace or jewelry at the smith. Acceptance consumes five distinct copies of the same required kind and the fee. It produces the magical necklace directly; a plain silver necklace is not the current reward. Keep the active-accounting payment guard until the service is qualified.

Ask gem, gems, cutting, cost, money or price. Acceptance consumes the exact material and two silver, then gives an amethyst. Cutting or obtaining a gem is separate from personally recovering it; no accepted source event is recorded by this checklist.

Ask necklace, platinum or disc at the magic shop. The required disc reference is missing. A similarly described disc exists elsewhere under a different identity and is not accepted by this contract. Select a valid disc/source and correct materials/reward before enabling the commission; the active-accounting fee guard remains.

stories.title: The paid platinum-disc rumor
stories.summary: For ten gold, the bartender describes a ranger who lost a platinum disc in Tethir and suspected a kobold. This is a paid information service, guarded under active accounting, with no item reward or quest achievement. The rumor does not create a disc, start a recovery objective or prove that any lead has been followed.

steps.hint: Ask disc, disk or platinum. The native payment is 1,000 copper and rewards only this rumor, keeping the bartender present. The named forest story and actual disc source need a separate builder review; conversation and a paid receipt do not prove personal recovery.
